description: Reuse-first retrieval hardening: parser emits section_catalog; retrieval auto-scopes blocks by shortlisted sections; frontend trace panel exposes query intents and selection reason
summary: Regression Guard converts the current `high`-risk change into an executable verification checklist. Focus on the high-priority checks first, then complete the medium and supporting checks before marking the change complete.

high_priority_checks.title: 项目回放快照回归
high_priority_checks.scope: 项目级章节生成、质量评分、历史基线对比
high_priority_checks.reason: Project replay snapshot must prove the latest implementation does not regress the delivered draft.
high_priority_checks.suggested_validation: 运行宿主级 release gate 或项目回放 gate，确认 snapshot health=healthy、章节 generated/passed 全通过，且 comparison.regression_count=0。

high_priority_checks.title: 接口契约与路由回归
high_priority_checks.scope: 状态码、字段结构、关键路由
high_priority_checks.reason: API contract and route-level regression checks
high_priority_checks.suggested_validation: 核对接口字段、状态码、异常分支与关键路由是否保持兼容。

high_priority_checks.title: 数据模型与持久层
high_priority_checks.reason: Data model, persistence, and migration regression checks
high_priority_checks.suggested_validation: 验证读写兼容性、历史数据兼容性以及迁移/回滚安全性。

medium_priority_checks.title: 关键 UI 路径与导航
medium_priority_checks.scope: 主页面、主按钮、状态切换、导航跳转
medium_priority_checks.reason: Critical UI paths, navigation, and state transition checks
medium_priority_checks.suggested_validation: 走一遍主界面、关键 CTA 和状态切换，确认没有视觉或交互回退。

medium_priority_checks.title: 邻近模块连带影响
medium_priority_checks.reason: 高置信度受影响模块需要额外检查相邻调用路径。
medium_priority_checks.suggested_validation: 对相邻模块做最小回归检查，确认没有隐藏耦合回退。

supporting_checks.title: 直接改动文件自检
supporting_checks.reason: 显式改动文件必须先完成最小自检，再扩大范围。
supporting_checks.suggested_validation: 逐个确认改动文件的输入、输出和异常分支没有被破坏。
